clips.title: The story
paras: Tucked away in Stormwind's Mage Quarter, the Slaughtered Lamb appears to be nothing more than a quiet, seedy tavern. Beneath its floorboards, however, sprawling catacombs hide the sanctum and training grounds of the Alliance's illicit warlocks.

On the surface, the Slaughtered Lamb offers little more than dark corners and sparse patronage, attended by barkeep Jarel Moor, who warns casual visitors to stay away from the shadows. That warning is literal. Descending through the back passages reveals a subterranean complex of crypts and summoning circles, where human warlocks and transfer practitioners from Khaz Modan openly study fel arcana sheltered from the disapproving eyes of the Church of the Holy Light and the Kirin Tor.
